column1: Curious, you sneak up and steal one from the wagon. It is a shoddy imitation of the guild's wares. Inside, you see workmen busily affixing the guild leader's stamp to each item.
column2: 你心生好奇，悄悄上前从大车上偷了一个。那是行会货品的粗劣仿制品。在里面，你看到工匠们正忙着把行会首领的印记盖在每一件东西上。

column1: Despite $his best efforts, $ChosenOneName just doesn't have enough speaking skill, local respect, and raw charisma to overcome the doubts of the guildsmen.
column2: 尽管$he尽了最大的努力，$ChosenOneName的口才、在当地的威望和天生的魅力都不足以打消工匠们的疑虑。

column1: However, $ChosenOneName isn't quite glib enough to induce the guildsmen to speak candidly about their leadership.
column2: 然而，$ChosenOneName的话还不够圆滑，无法诱使工匠们坦率地谈论他们的领导。

column1: Monstrous dwarf magic fills the air and you realize that $ChosenOneName has chosen the wrong knob. $He cries out in surprise and pain as the magic constricts $his limbs and body. When the effect ends, you are amazed to see that your leader's arms and legs have each shrunk by a half-inch, thus hampering $his agility.
